verdict.rationale: The only related capability is Warehouse Sync, which ingests data from your own Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery or Databricks warehouse into mParticle via a documented API and mapping. That could serve as a workaround for backfilling history from your own archive. Nothing shows mParticle archiving events itself or replaying them into a newly added destination, and the Feeds and forwarding items are titles only. Missing for 10: native event archive and replay, per-destination backfill or replay controls, documented recovery from pipeline breaks, independent or hands-on corroboration.
